Question ID: ANP_U02_L01_GP_Q01
MLA Standard: MLA.ANP.TIS.02

Guided practice item 1.
Lesson focus: Human Cells and Cell Regulation
Stimulus: Cell-cycle/cancer model

A student is reviewing the required visual and must explain the first visible structure-function connection. Which answer uses the lesson evidence most accurately?

generalfeedback.text: Teachable feedback: First, trace interphase, mitosis, and cytokinesis. Then use the required stimulus (Cell-cycle/cancer model) to connect the visible evidence to cell cycle regulation and uncontrolled cell growth. Correct reasoning stays inside MLA.ANP.TIS.02 and avoids the common mistake: thinking mitosis is automatically harmful.
